_notes: Four-step quote request. The website stores nothing: the last step opens the visitor's own email app with the request written out (mailto), and a copy-able summary is shown in case no email app opens. 'steps' defines fields; 'messages' covers form-level states. Field names are stable.

seo.title: Get a Free Landscaping Quote | RNC Landscaping Victoria
seo.description: Tell us about your property and project in a few short steps and RNC Landscaping will follow up to arrange your free quote anywhere in Greater Victoria.

lede: Four short steps, then your email app opens with everything written out, ready to send. A quote costs nothing and comes with no obligation.

aside.heading: What happens next
items: We get back to you to ask any questions and arrange a site visit if needed.
You get a written quote with the scope and schedule.

steps.intro: Nothing is sent until you press send in your email app. We use these details only to reply to your request, as set out in the [privacy policy](/privacy/).

ready.body: Your email app should now show your request, addressed to [EMAIL]. Attach any photos, then press send. If nothing opened, copy the request below and email it to us, or call [PHONE].

sections.heading: Prefer to talk?
body: Call [PHONE] or email [EMAIL]. See [contact details](/contact/) and [common questions](/faq/).
